mentions.name: Sci-fi dungeon crawler (Haskell)
mentions.description: This is a sci-fi dungeon crawler game written in Haskell, currently finishing an OpenGL-based 2.5D graphics engine with a real 3D dynamic lighting system in which in-game objects and entities cast realistic soft shadows and are lit realistically; implementing gameplay is the next step.
mentions.source_excerpt: On my spare time, I am working on my game, a sci fi dungeon crawler – written in Haskell. Currently finishing up the graphics engine. OpenGL based. 2.5D but with a real 3D dynamic light system.
